messages.subject: Re: multilevel mediation
parts:
This tutorial page shows what a mediation model looks like, from which you can extrapolate to an additional predictor.

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/mediation.html

And here is an example ML-SEM:  https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/multilevel.html
Though it is a factor model, it does show how to specify "blocks" of syntax corresponding to each level of analysis.
